note: Set A covers more of the page's substantive text claims correctly — the high intrinsic drivetrain structural damping (and hence no damping control loop), the single-DOF model with the shaft angular rotation as the DOF, and the gain-scheduled PI control type — none of which appear in B. Set B is somewhat cleaner on the generator-torque conditional (it captures the full 'computed as if in Region 3 regardless of generator speed' logic, which A only half-covers) and avoids A's doctored quote ('[value missing] N·m/s') and its misbinding of 1173.7 rpm to a 'filtered generator rated speed'. Both sets are padded with duplicate and legend-only chart reads, and B adds two mutually inconsistent endpoint values (35,000 and 36,000 N·m at 1400 rpm) plus two vague 'not specified' claims. On balance A's extra correct engineering facts outweigh its slightly larger error count.
